architecture.world_model: grounded historical replay only; no learned latent dynamics
architecture.jev_role: optional bounded SystemOne advisory layer; shadow-first; no promotion or execution authority
architecture.policy_interface: one AdaptiveReplayPolicy shared by replay and live adapters
architecture.qualification: persistent development/validation/qualification world assignments; HMAC-attested results and an independent-data live canary gate promotion
architecture.trusted_evaluation: host invokes content-pinned search and optional independent canary evaluator subprocesses in fail-closed macOS Seatbelt or Linux Bubblewrap sandboxes, with bytecode disabled, read-only inputs, bounded resources, and content-addressed evidence; disabled by default
architecture.execution: strict fail-closed Bubblewrap or Docker/Podman OCI sandbox; insecure process mode only by explicit opt-in
architecture.parallelism: effective live parallelism 1; replay parallel bonus 0

v1_3_upgrades: serialized JEV node evidence and replay-world schema v3

known_limitations: task-specific hidden-data evaluator and data/split contract are not included; trusted evaluation remains disabled until an operator supplies and pins a reviewed bundle
HMAC evaluator attestation is symmetric and depends on protecting the shared key and validating evaluator/data identities before signing
the HMAC signer is not a dedicated UID or signing service; host process compromise can expose the symmetric key
replay-world splitting is not a holdout-data boundary; validation and qualification reuse discovery scores and do not establish untouched generalization
candidate isolation inside the operator-supplied evaluator and separate validation and one-shot qualification datasets require task-specific adapters not implemented here
the host trusts the task evaluator's metric implementation and does not independently recompute it from labels and predictions

environment identity records platform and restricted PATH values but does not bind a container image, system libraries, GPU driver, or the contents of every executable reachable through allowed runtime paths
replay cannot generate unseen branch outcomes
Linux Bubblewrap evaluator confinement and resource limits must be integration-tested on the deployment host
